images: roles tune_cal,tune_eval of the saved match-correction split (ADE validation, development data); no filtering.
wording: ade-natural-v1 prompts for every arm, FC-CLIP's 14 ViLD templates averaged (its released prompt engineering).
catseg: Released FC-CLIP ConvNeXt-L (COCO panoptic weights), a847 evaluation config: shortest edge 800 (max 1333), 250 queries, geometric ensemble alpha .4 (COCO names) / beta .8 (other names).
native: Released semantic inference: in-/out-of-vocabulary logits softmaxed over the deployed vocabulary, ensembled, softmaxed, times one minus the void probability; masks weighted by the result. Source scores use the 150-label softmaxes, expanded scores the 845-label ones.
anchored: Reference-anchored conversion (stored as anchored845): every softmax over the deployed vocabulary becomes a softmax over {label} + the reference bank (the training vocabulary, COCO panoptic 133 with released synonyms; the label's own entry removed from the bank side), the void term a softmax over bank + void; same ensemble weights (alpha for training names, beta otherwise, on candidates and bank entries alike). Candidate-independent by construction; equals the released pipeline run on the bank vocabulary for bank labels (up to FC-CLIP's max over synonyms).
stores: log(score + 1e-8) clamped to [-30, 30]; scores are mask-weighted sums (not probabilities).
reference_overlap: 55 of 150 source prompts and 88 of 845 prompts are COCO panoptic training names.
scope: Development images (ADE validation); no fitting, no calibration, no reserve access. FC-CLIP was trained on COCO panoptic; these images are unseen by it.
